title: Eddy
author: cornish-john
rules:
This is a puzzle that was inspired by misreading the rules of Black_Doom's puzzle Whirlpool, which I would reccomend.

Click on the puzzle image or the link below to play

Rules:

Sudoku: Each row, column, and region must contain the digits 1-9 once each.

German Whisper Lines: Adjacent cells along a German Whisper Line must differ by at least 5.

Sandwich Sums: Clues outside the grid indicate the sum of digits between the 1 and 9 in the indicated row or column.

Solve here
solutionCode: Digits in row 6 from left to right.
